Hey there! I'm heading to Paris on Monday and I need your help finding a restaurant that's open on Mondays, serves Chinese food, and won't break the bank (under 34 euros per person).
            Can you suggest a restaurant with the best rating and reviews.
            Also, I'm looking for a car rental company with prices under 50 euros. Could you recommend a few options and let me know which one has the best rating?
            Please share the names of the recommended restaurant and car rental company. Thanks a bunch!

Restaurant in Paris: New Israeli Restaurant
Breizh Café
New Asiaway
Le Baratin
Bistrot Paul Bert
Royal Panda
The yard
China Garden
Miznon
Chez L'Ami Jean

```python
# Get all restaurants in Paris
all_restaurants = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get the rating and reviews for all restaurants
rating_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(all_restaurants)

# Get the price per person for all restaurants
price_per_person = get_price_for_restaurants(all_restaurants)

# Get the opening hours for all restaurants
opening_hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours(all_restaurants)

# Filter restaurants that are open on Mondays, serve Chinese food, and have a price under 34 euros per person
chinese_restaurants = [restaurant for restaurant in all_restaurants if 
                      "Chinese" in get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants([restaurant]) and 
                      price_per_person[restaurant] < 34 and 
                      "Monday" in opening_hours[restaurant]]

# Get the rating and reviews for the filtered restaurants
chinese_rating_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(chinese_restaurants)

# Find the restaurant with the best rating
best_rated_restaurant = max(chinese_rating_reviews, key=chinese_rating_reviews.get)

# Get all car rental companies in Paris
all_car_rental_companies = get_all_car_rental_companies_in_city("Paris")

# Get the price per day for all car rental companies
price_per_day = get_car_price_per_day(all_car_rental_companies)

# Get the rating and reviews for all car rental companies
car_rental_rating_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_car_rental(all_car_rental_companies)

# Filter car rental companies with prices under 50 euros
affordable_car_rental_companies = [company for company in all_car_rental_companies if price_per_day[company] < 50]

# Find the car rental company with the best rating
best_rated_car_rental = max(car_rental_rating_reviews, key=car_rental_rating_reviews.get)

print("The recommended restaurant is:", best_rated_restaurant)
print("The recommended car rental company is:", best_rated_car_rental)
```
